name: aether-cli
description: A lightweight, multi-model CLI AI coding agent for Termux on Android. Generate, review, and test code through any LLM provider — provider-agnostic, offline-ready, all from your terminal.

scripts.build: bun build src/cli.ts --outfile dist/cli.js --target node --format cjs && bun build src/cli.ts --outfile dist/cli.bun.js --target bun --format esm
scripts.build:bun: bun build src/cli.ts --outfile dist/cli.bun.js --target bun --format esm
scripts.start: if command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ "${AETHER_FORCE_NODE:-0}" != "1" ]; then bun run dist/cli.bun.js; else node dist/cli.js; fi

author: Aether CLI Contributors
